title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - SecondaryRawResource
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/SecondaryRawResource. Resource that is obtained from one that has already been processed or used (source: ISO 59004:2024, clause 3.3.5). Subclass of s4envi:Resource (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.3.3.2.5); location is inherited from the Resource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SecondaryRawResource'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasCreationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasCreationDate'. Final waste and secondary raw resources have a creation date that corresponds to the date on which their creation was completed. (ontology restriction: maximum 1).

resourceKind.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from saref:hasFeatureKind whose range is s4envi:SecondaryRawResourceKind. Known individuals (non-exhaustive): 'Compost', 'SecondaryElectricity', 'SecondaryEnergy', 'SecondaryHeat'.
